A layout table renders its rows as list items, and those markers honour the bullets option like any other list

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
use HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions;
$options = \HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions::from_json(json_encode(["bullets" => "*+-"]));
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<table><tr><td>alpha</td><td>beta</td></tr><tr><td>a</td><td>b</td><td>c</td></tr></table>", $options);
var_dump($result->content);
```
